state.store_guard: reserve: if (!owned() || OWNER->next != phase || OWNER->committed < OWNER->from || npu_cold_txbuf_recipe(&plan, phase, OWNER->committed - OWNER->from, &store) || address != store.address || width != store.bytes || data != store.value) return fail(); Only after that test succeeds does reserve call value(address,width). publish likewise checks owned, next, published/from, recipe, exact address and width before value(address,width). Removing only begin's value check still returns EPROTO and leaves step counters unchanged after invoking the modeled callback and failing finish. state.callback_failure_propagation: Original API21 callback wrapper ignores its helper return and returns1. Native store-hook fault invokes fail(), which marks the TX-buffer owner faulty and invokes npu_admission_fail on admission/barrier. owned() calls context(), and descriptor_prior_live in context requires admission/barrier not faulty.
